name: Bendbound/Failed requests
queryString:
fields @timestamp, requestId, path, status, code, durationMs, input, startRoads, diagnostics
| filter event = "request.completed" and status >= 400
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

name: Bendbound/Find request reference
queryString:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
| filter requestId = "PASTE_REFERENCE_HERE"
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 100

name: Bendbound/Route latency and failures
queryString:
filter event = "request.completed" and path = "/round-trip"
| stats count(*) as requests, avg(durationMs) as averageMs, pct(durationMs, 95) as p95Ms by bin(5m), status
